bullets.text: sharpening the kitchen knife on the wrong stone. it got sharper anyway. the stone has opinions i don't share.
duck still at okunoin. rain glyph, and rain to match it. today's line: mind for others, no mind for yourself.
the gutter has one gap. the rain found it by noon and stayed with it until dark.
quiet, but not the resting kind. just quiet.
the umbrella drips in the hallway like it's working something out.
